request.query: index of polynomial bounded height recursive supremum finite maximum

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_eq_of_max
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {b : B},
  b ∈ Set.range D → Function.invFun D b ∈ p.support → (∀ a ∈ p.support, D a ≤ b) → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p = b

items.name: sup_eq_of_isMaxOn
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : SemilatticeSup β] [inst_1 : OrderBot β] {D : α → β} {s : Finset α} {a : α},
  a ∈ s → IsMaxOn D (↑s) a → s.sup D = D a

items.name: iSup
items.type: {α : Type u} → {ι : Sort v} → [SupSet α] → (ι → α) → α

items.name: Polynomial.degree_sum_le
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {ι : Type u_1} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Polynomial R),
  (∑ i ∈ s, f i).degree ≤ s.sup fun b => (f b).degree

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_eq_of_isMaxOn
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {a : A},
  a ∈ p.support → IsMaxOn D (↑p.support) a → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p = D a

items.name: Polynomial.supDegree_eq_natDegree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree id p.toFinsupp = p.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.height_map_C
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (p : Ideal R) [p.IsMaximal],
  (Ideal.map Polynomial.C p).height = p.height

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree_sum_lt
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} {ι : Type u_7} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A},
  s.Nonempty →
    ∀ {b : B}, (∀ i ∈ s, AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D (f i) < b) → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D (∑ i ∈ s, f i) < b
